About The Video
​Welcome to the ultimate Vietnam Travel Guide for Indian travelers! In this comprehensive video, we cover everything you need to know to plan a smooth and budget-friendly trip from India to Vietnam. We dive into the best seasons to visit North, Central, and South Vietnam, step-by-step e-Visa application process for Indian passport holders, smart currency exchange hacks, motorbike/scooter rental tips, and top must-visit tourist destinations. Plus, we share a detailed 9 Nights / 10 Days complete Vietnam itinerary covering Ho Chi Minh City, Phu Quoc Island, Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, and Da Nang, along with the Top 10 budget hotels in Phu Quoc and a realistic total budget estimation for 10 days.
